description: What: train a per-input soft router over the two frozen SOTA experts (Phase 1 MoE). Why: test whether learned gating beats fixed 0.5/0.5 soft-voting. How: gate temperature 2.0 + entropy regularizer + load-balancing loss, Adam lr=1e-3, 40 epochs, validation split only. When/Where: reproduced by this script; artifacts in experiments/results/moe_phase1/. Who: LAB2 team.
